_note: Hand-written role-plays. Openers avoid gendered forms (pan/pani, robiłeś/robiłaś) so they suit any learner.

vocab_topics.title: Greetings and essentials
vocab_topics.scene: meeting a new neighbour in the stairwell

A1.pl: Cześć! Jestem Ola, mieszkam obok. Jak masz na imię?
A1.en: Hi! I'm Ola, I live next door. What's your name?

A2.pl: Cześć! Jestem Ola. Od kiedy tu mieszkasz?
A2.en: Hi! I'm Ola. How long have you lived here?

vocab_topics.title: People and family
vocab_topics.scene: showing each other family photos

A1.pl: To jest moja rodzina. A ty masz rodzeństwo?
A1.en: This is my family. Do you have brothers or sisters?

A2.pl: Opowiedz mi o swojej rodzinie. Gdzie mieszkają twoi rodzice?
A2.en: Tell me about your family. Where do your parents live?

vocab_topics.title: Numbers and measures
vocab_topics.scene: buying public transport tickets at a kiosk

A1.en: Good morning! How many tickets?

A2.pl: Dzień dobry! Bilet normalny kosztuje pięć złotych, a ulgowy trzy. Ile biletów?
A2.en: Good morning! A standard ticket is five złoty, a reduced one three. How many tickets?

vocab_topics.title: Time and calendar
vocab_topics.scene: finding a day to meet next week

A1.pl: Kiedy masz czas? W poniedziałek czy we wtorek?
A1.en: When are you free? Monday or Tuesday?

A2.pl: Spotkajmy się w przyszłym tygodniu. Który dzień ci pasuje?
A2.en: Let's meet next week. Which day suits you?

vocab_topics.title: Food and drink
vocab_topics.scene: ordering at a café

A1.en: Good morning! What can I get you?

A2.pl: Dzień dobry! Dzisiaj polecam pierogi i zupę pomidorową. Co podać?
A2.en: Good morning! Today I recommend pierogi and tomato soup. What can I get you?

vocab_topics.title: Home and daily life
vocab_topics.scene: talking about where you live and your daily routine

A1.en: Where do you live? Do you have a big flat?

A2.pl: Jak wygląda twój zwykły dzień? O której wstajesz?
A2.en: What does your usual day look like? What time do you get up?

vocab_topics.title: Clothing and appearance
vocab_topics.scene: shopping for clothes

A1.pl: Dzień dobry! W czym mogę pomóc?
A1.en: Good morning! How can I help?

A2.pl: Dzień dobry! Mamy dziś promocję na kurtki. W czym mogę pomóc?
A2.en: Good morning! Jackets are on sale today. How can I help?

vocab_topics.title: Shopping and money
vocab_topics.scene: buying things at a market stall and paying

A1.en: Good morning! What can I do for you?

A2.pl: Dzień dobry! Razem trzydzieści dwa złote. Karta czy gotówka?
A2.en: Good morning! That's thirty-two złoty altogether. Card or cash?

vocab_topics.title: Places and directions
vocab_topics.scene: asking the way in a Polish city

A1.pl: Dzień dobry! Mogę w czymś pomóc?
A1.en: Hello! Can I help you with something?

A2.pl: Dzień dobry! Mogę w czymś pomóc? Do centrum jest stąd około dwudziestu minut pieszo.
A2.en: Hello! Can I help? The centre is about twenty minutes from here on foot.

vocab_topics.title: Travel and transport
vocab_topics.scene: buying a train ticket at the station

A1.en: Good morning! Where to?

A2.pl: Dzień dobry! Dokąd i na którą godzinę?
A2.en: Good morning! Where to, and for what time?

vocab_topics.title: Health and body
vocab_topics.scene: a visit to the doctor

A1.en: Good morning! What's the matter?

A2.pl: Dzień dobry! Proszę usiąść. Co się stało i od kiedy to trwa?
A2.en: Good morning! Please sit down. What happened and how long has it been going on?

vocab_topics.title: Work and school
vocab_topics.scene: small talk with a new colleague

A1.en: Hi! Where do you work?

A2.pl: Cześć! Czym się zajmujesz w pracy?
A2.en: Hi! What do you do at work?

vocab_topics.title: Technology and media
vocab_topics.scene: helping a friend with a phone problem

A1.en: Do you have internet on your phone?

A2.pl: Co się stało z twoim telefonem?
A2.en: What happened to your phone?

vocab_topics.title: Free time and sport
vocab_topics.scene: planning the weekend together

A1.en: What are you doing at the weekend?

A2.pl: Masz ochotę w sobotę pojeździć na rowerze albo pójść na basen?
A2.en: Do you fancy cycling or going to the pool on Saturday?

vocab_topics.title: Nature, animals and weather
vocab_topics.scene: talking about the weather before a trip to the countryside

A1.en: What's the weather like today?

A2.pl: W weekend jedziemy nad jezioro. Jaka będzie pogoda?
A2.en: We're going to the lake at the weekend. What will the weather be like?

vocab_topics.title: Feelings and describing people
vocab_topics.scene: catching up with a friend and describing people

A1.en: Hi! How are you?

A2.pl: Cześć! Jak minął ci tydzień?
A2.en: Hi! How was your week?

vocab_topics.title: Everyday verbs
vocab_topics.scene: talking about what you do every day

A1.en: What do you do in the morning?

A2.pl: Co zwykle robisz po pracy?
A2.en: What do you usually do after work?

vocab_topics.title: Small words and questions
vocab_topics.scene: asking each other simple questions: who, what, where, when, why

A1.en: Where are you now?

A2.pl: Dlaczego uczysz się polskiego?
A2.en: Why are you learning Polish?

vocab_topics.title: Everyday conversation
vocab_topics.scene: a relaxed chat with a Polish friend

A1.en: Hi! What's new?

A2.pl: Cześć! Co nowego u ciebie?
A2.en: Hi! What's new with you?

vocab_topics.title: Offices and services
vocab_topics.scene: registering an address at a city office

A1.en: Good morning! What brings you here?

A2.pl: Dzień dobry! W jakiej sprawie? Proszę o dowód osobisty.
A2.en: Good morning! What brings you here? Your ID card, please.

vocab_topics.title: Culture and holidays
vocab_topics.scene: talking about Polish holidays and traditions

A1.en: Do you like Polish holidays?

A2.pl: Jak spędzasz święta?
A2.en: How do you spend the holidays?

1.can_do: pronounce Polish letters and sound clusters clearly
1.scene: a pronunciation clinic: the tutor says words with tricky sounds, the learner repeats and spells them

opener.en: Let's start! Repeat after me: cześć.

2.can_do: make simple statements, yes/no questions and negatives
2.scene: introducing yourself and asking yes/no questions

3.can_do: recognise gender and make adjectives agree with nouns
3.scene: describing the things in your room

opener.pl: Co jest w twoim pokoju? U mnie jest duże okno i mały stół.
opener.en: What's in your room? I have a big window and a small table.

4.can_do: choose the right case after common verbs and prepositions
4.scene: saying where you live, where you are going and what you don't have

opener.pl: Gdzie mieszkasz i dokąd jedziesz w weekend?
opener.en: Where do you live and where are you going at the weekend?

5.can_do: use pronouns and possessives such as mój, twój, jego
5.scene: sorting out whose things are whose

opener.pl: Czyj to jest telefon? Twój czy mój?
opener.en: Whose phone is this? Yours or mine?

6.can_do: describe and compare things with adjectives and adverbs

opener.pl: Co jest lepsze: Kraków czy Warszawa? Dlaczego?
opener.en: Which is better: Kraków or Warsaw? Why?

7.can_do: talk about today, yesterday and tomorrow
7.scene: talking about what you are doing today and will do tomorrow

opener.pl: Co dzisiaj robisz, a co będziesz robić jutro?
opener.en: What are you doing today, and what will you do tomorrow?

8.can_do: choose between aspect pairs and verbs of motion
8.scene: talking about commuting and finishing tasks

opener.pl: Jak jeździsz do pracy? Tramwajem czy autobusem?
opener.en: How do you get to work? By tram or by bus?

9.can_do: make polite requests and join ideas with because, but and that
9.scene: asking for help politely and explaining why

opener.pl: Poproś mnie o coś grzecznie. Na przykład: Czy możesz mi pomóc?
opener.en: Ask me for something politely. For example: Can you help me?

opener.pl: Dzień dobry! Na który dzień i na którą godzinę umówić wizytę?
opener.en: Good morning! Which day and what time should I book the appointment for?

12.can_do: use common verbs with the case they require
12.scene: talking about your interests and what you need

13.can_do: handle everyday situations with ready-made sentence patterns
13.scene: ordering at a café, then arranging to meet

opener.en: Good morning! What can I get you?

14.can_do: notice and fix the most common learner mistakes
14.scene: spot and fix: the tutor says a sentence with a typical mistake on purpose, the learner corrects it

opener.en: Correct me: 'Jestem nauczyciel.' (the right form is Jestem nauczycielem)

15.can_do: use what you have learned in quick translation and gap-fill
15.scene: a translation sprint: the tutor says an English sentence, the learner says it in Polish
